description: Google Play facts the Android build is checked against. Recheck against the sources before each first upload after a policy date; Play raises minTargetSdk every August. WAKE_LOCK and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE are merged from WorkManager. The app starts one foreground service, the owner-enabled on-phone WhatsApp worker (foregroundServices below).

permissionJustifications.android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE: Runs the owner-enabled on-phone WhatsApp worker as a visible foreground service (also merged from WorkManager).
permissionJustifications.android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_RE: The on-phone WhatsApp worker relays the owner's own messages between their linked WhatsApp account on this phone and their Grogoni inbox: the remoteMessaging use case.
permissionJustifications.android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE: Restarts the on-phone WhatsApp worker after a reboot, only when the signed-in owner had turned it on (also merged from WorkManager for SMS recovery).
permissionJustifications.android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT: Normal, deprecated permission merged from androidx.biometric (pulled in by androidx.credentials). The device-unlock prompt needs it for fingerprint on Android 6 to 8.1 (minSdk 23).

market.grogoni.app.whatsapp.sidecar.What.startedBy: The owner's explicit 'Run WhatsApp on this phone' action, app launch while it is on, and BOOT_COMPLETED / MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED while it is on
market.grogoni.app.whatsapp.sidecar.What.userVisible: Ongoing low-importance notification with a Stop action for as long as it runs

ownerDecisions.summary: The on-phone WhatsApp worker bundles libsignal@6.0.0 (GPL-3.0) inside the APK and App Bundle. Distribution licence review is the owner's decision; the notice ships in assets/whatsapp-sidecar/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.
